name: git-multistage
description: Records each agent's file edits in its own git-multistage stage, so agents that share a checkout commit only their own changes.

interface.shortDescription: Separate staging areas for agents that share a checkout
interface.longDescription: Records each file edit an agent makes in that agent's own git-multistage stage. The agent then stages and commits exactly its own edits, while other agents commit from the same checkout. Requires the git-multistage binary on PATH.
